changelog: v0.4.4: 1) Non-Blocking Floating Diagnostics HUD Window: converted diagnostics from a blocking modal into a draggable, minimizable floating HUD window that leaves the 3D scene, avatar, and controls fully visible and interactive; 2) Relocated Debug Controls to Settings: removed the 🐞 icon from the main screen for a clean consumer UI and placed all diagnostic controls inside Companion Settings (⚙️); 3) Multi-level Debug Verbosity: added 'Standard' vs 'Verbose' diagnostic levels; 4) Deep TTS & Hardware Profiler: instrumented Neural TTS with millisecond ONNX execution time, Real-Time Factor (RTF), character throughput, JS memory heap usage, CPU concurrency, and WebAssembly multi-threading status (SharedArrayBuffer) to analyze and diagnose exact speech synthesis bottlenecks on Meta Quest 3.
